draft_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise: its F1 drop stayed within the pre-specified criterion at 10%, 20% and 30% noise (0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points).
rationale: The package contains only exp1 (original labels) with Table T1; no label-noise perturbation experiments, no T2 table, and no F1-drop values (0.6, 1.3, 1.8) are reported anywhere. The cited evidence IDs (T2.r1–r3) do not exist in the package. The claim is entirely unsupported.
